change: The uint64 full-constructor semantics is now enforced: the Real population-statistics claims explicitly require N < 2^64 to exclude count wraparound. This corrects the old overbroad all-Nat Real claim; formulas are unchanged. Public FP specifications already require N <= CountConversion.limit and retain their original headers. Python and quoted Lean kernels are byte-identical to the published source.
